name: Aditya Shah
player_statement:
A complete player, Aditya Shah has made a big mark in cricket. With 31 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 42, with an average of 17.71 and a quick strike rate of 134.78. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 19 sixes and 31 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 15.0 overs, taking 9 wickets at an economy rate of 8.60. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
